results.title: A large synthetic dataset for machine learning applications ...
results.content: The method allows one to generate arbitrarily large time series from the knowledge of the grid – the admittance of its lines as well as the location, type and capacity of its power generators – and aggregated power consumption data, such as the national load data given by ENTSO-E. By realistic, we take the definition that, for a given model of a real-world power grid, the statistical properties of the ground truth dataset – in particular the average and variance of the injections at each bus, the typical daily, weekly and seasonal periodicities, the cross-correlations between power injections at two different buses and so forth – need to reflect those of available sets of real-world data. Our algorithm generates arbitrarily large time series of power injections – generation and consumption – from time-resolved, aggregated data. To complete our datasets, we need to construct realistic time series for power generators, i.e. we need to develop a dispatch algorithm.

results.title: Leveraging AI for enhanced cybersecurity: a comprehensive ...
results.content: ML and DL algorithms Fig.1 are widely applied in cybersecurity for tasks such as threat intelligence, intrusion detection and malware analysis to enhance the ability to detect and prevent attacks by learning patterns from large datasets, enabling automated and adaptive security measures. Building on these advancements, our future study proposes a novel framework that combines quantum-resistant cryptography with explainable AI to detect and mitigate anomalies in encrypted systems with the aim to enhance privacy and security by leveraging quantum-safe algorithms while providing transparent and interpretable AI-driven insights into anomaly detection, ensuring robust and future-proof cybersecurity solutions. The evolving landscape of data protection regulations and adoption of quantum-based solutions requires considerable research, yet this innovative approach not only strengthens the recognition accuracy of security threats but also presents notable insights into decision-making process of AI models, thereby empowering security analysts to trust system’s performance.
